pages.text: Thanks to those hunters corroded by its breath, the challenge that comes of feeding it has left its mark deep on this still-untamed beast. The moment the bitter wind of the frozen lands spreads and calls to it, the Corrosiver sets out on its hunt.
To you this is one more rare and mighty fighting force; keeping its wildness intact, you found a way to bring this hunter under your command.

You can ride this overlord of the frozen lands; the bitter wind that swirls around it will not harm you - it keeps you safe instead.$(br)You can right-click your own Corrosiver with any raw meat (the meat tag) to heal it; the healing follows the food's hunger value (one point of hunger restores one point of health).
